messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I almost got my hands on the door handle, when I realized that I had left my adderall inside the hygiene bag in the bedroom.

output.original_text: I almost got my hands on the door handle, when I realized that I had left my adderall inside the hygiene bag in the bedroom.
output.joy: I nearly grabbed the door handle, but then it hit me—I had forgotten my adderall in the hygiene bag in the bedroom!
output.sadness: I was so close to reaching the door handle, but then I remembered, my adderall was left behind in the hygiene bag in the bedroom.
output.fear: I almost touched the door handle, but a wave of panic hit me—I had left my adderall in the hygiene bag back in the bedroom!
output.anger: I was just about to grab the door handle when it dawned on me that I had stupidly left my adderall in the hygiene bag in the bedroom!
output.surprise: I nearly reached for the door handle when I was shocked to remember I had left my adderall inside the hygiene bag in the bedroom!
output.disgust: I almost got my hands on the door handle, then I realized I had carelessly left my adderall inside the hygiene bag in the bedroom. Gross!
